name: Jump for Soccer Players! ⚽
desc:
Welcome to Jump for Soccer Players! 🤗

How to Play:
✨ Jump up and grab  Soccer Players that spawn!
📦 Bring them back to your base to open!
🔋 Upgrade your jump power to jump even higher!
🏗️ Upgrade your base for even more slots!

Remember to like & favorite the game for updates! 👍⭐
